newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BESI Q2 PROFIT 4.8 MLN GUILDERS.
newsitem.headline: BESI Q2 PROFIT 4.8 MLN GUILDERS.

text.p: (in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated)
Note - Full name is BE Semiconductors Industries NV (BESI), Dutch unit of Berliner Elektro Holding AG.
(in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated)
The pro forma financial information reflects the leadframes business of BE Semiconductor, which was put into a new joint venture, PBE, as of May 30, 1997. BESI owns 30 pct of PBE.

The pro forma financial information, in which the results of the leadframes business are excluded from the consolidated results of operations and presented on an on-line basis, is provided solely to allow a comparison of BESI's systems business and is not presented in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles.
